snippet.title: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Are you ready to embrace the power of spirits and rebuild your legacy?

Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite RPG with monster taming elements, inspired by indigenous South American mythology.

Recruit creatures, explore dangerous lands, and fight to restore your people.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028370/Tupi_The_Legend_of_Arariboia/

🔥 About the Game

🌿 Mythology-Inspired World
• Explore a world based on South American indigenous myths
• Encounter creatures from nature and legend

⚔️ Tactical Turn-Based Combat
• Position your team strategically on a grid
• Use abilities that depend on positioning

🐾 Monster Taming System
• Capture enemies and recruit them as allies
• Build a powerful and diverse team

🔮 Fusion Mechanics
• Combine creatures to create stronger ones
• Experiment with different builds and strategies

🌗 Roguelite Exploration
• Semi-randomized maps and events
• Day/night cycle affecting difficulty and rewards

🏡 Settlement Management
• Upgrade your village hub between runs
• Unlock new abilities and progression systems

🧠 Strategic Depth
• Balance risk and reward in every run
• Adapt your strategy as challenges evolve
